description: A simulation, not an observation: a model of the Sun's magnetic network whose texture statistics were calibrated against one NASA SDO AIA 304 frame (see scripts/sun/). The first frame of the simulated video.
credit: Simulated for this site; calibrated against NASA Goddard Space Flight Center/SDO imagery
transforms: First decoded frame of sun-simulated-large.mp4 (BT.709 to RGB), WebP quality 80. No crop, rotation, or recoloring.
